summary: The page fully conforms to the brief and plan. It methodically covers software evaluation across four subsections: building a functional matrix linking qualification, receiving, and SCARs; testing decision gates and human-in-the-loop review for automated suggestions; verifying audit trails and role-based permissions; and evaluating licensing models, deployment scope, and integration boundaries. Primary claims from both the ISO 9001 APG external providers guidance and the ICC Supplier Quality module documentation are accurately integrated and properly cited. All assigned workflow roles, inputs, decisions, records, exceptions, evaluation criteria, and labeled illustrative examples are present. No unassigned FAQ section was included, respecting boundary and structure rules.
